source_page_html:
Foundry House — Commercial Office Retrofit

Procurement type: Construction tender. Buyer: Calder Fen Commercial Estates Ltd. Project location: 26 Foundry Lane, Salford, Greater Manchester, United Kingdom.

Overall scope

Retrofit a four-storey commercial office building for multi-tenant use. The works include internal reconfiguration, thermal upgrades to the roof and external walls, replacement of building services, and improvements to the entrance and shared areas.

Packages

  • Lot 1 — Internal refurbishment: strip-out, partitions, ceilings, floor finishes, entrance alterations, and shared-area fit-out. Estimated value: GBP 2,850,000.
  • Lot 2 — Building envelope upgrades: roof insulation, external wall insulation, replacement windows, and associated weatherproofing. Estimated value: GBP 1,720,000.
  • Lot 3 — Building services: heating and ventilation, electrical distribution, LED lighting, controls, and plumbing upgrades. Estimated value: GBP 2,360,000.

Eligibility

  • Demonstrate delivery of two comparable occupied commercial refurbishment projects within the past six years.
  • Provide evidence of relevant health and safety management arrangements and site supervision.
  • Submit a project-specific method statement addressing phased work and protection of building users.
  • Provide current employers' liability and public liability insurance details.

Key dates

Published: 2026-04-02. Site visit: 2026-04-09 at 10:30. Questions due: 2026-04-14 at 12:00. Tenders due: 2026-04-28 at 12:00. All times are British Summer Time (BST).

Submission

Submit through the Calder Fen procurement portal and deliver two bound paper copies to the tender office. No portal web address is stated in this notice.

Paper delivery address: Tender Office, 26 Foundry Lane, Salford, Greater Manchester M5 4AB, United Kingdom.

Electronic files must be searchable PDF documents, with the completed pricing workbook provided as an editable spreadsheet.

  • Completed tender response and pricing workbook
  • Project references and proposed delivery team
  • Project-specific phased-work method statement
  • Health and safety management information
  • Employers' liability and public liability insurance details
  • Outline programme and proposed start-up period

Contact

Oliver Grant, Estates Procurement Lead, Calder Fen Commercial Estates Ltd.
